title: Structure-sheaf cohomology dimensions are invariant under isomorphisms over a field
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $X,Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $e:X\xrightarrow{\sim}Y$, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ satisfy $g e=f$. For every $q\in\mathbf N$, the $k$-dimensions of $H^q(X,\mathcal O_X)$ and $H^q(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$ [def-sc-sheaf-cohomology-functor] agree. Here both groups are the module right-derived global sections, and the $k$-action is restriction along the inverse of GammaSpecIso followed by the global-functions map of f, respectively g. Dimension is Module.finrank, so no finiteness assumption is imposed. Empty schemes and q=0 are included.

source.place: section-cohomology-sheaves (Tag 01DZ), module-derived global sections and invariance under exact equivalence; source-library comparison and affine isomorphism cohomology lemmas.

proof.text: Use exists_moduleCohomology_source_comparison to identify module cohomology additively with the source ordinary H, naturally in the coefficient module. Apply its naturality to multiplication by a global section coming from k. moduleCohomology_scalar_endomorphism identifies the action on the module-derived side with scalar multiplication. Thus the comparison is k-linear for the restricted scalar action, and its finrank equality applies.

Install the specified k-scheme structure maps f and g. The equation e.hom followed by g equals f makes e.hom a map over k. The structure sheaf is quasi-coherent and its pullback along e.hom is the structure sheaf. Apply the source finrankH_pullback_of_isIso (derived from affine-pushforward cohomology invariance) and finrankH_congr to obtain equality of ordinary-H dimensions.
Compose this equality with the two scalar-linear comparison equalities from step 1. This establishes exactly the numerical equality for the module-derived cohomology objects in the statement.

lean.statement:
theorem finrank_structureSheafCohomology_iso
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ≅ Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (he : e.hom ≫ g = f) (q : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank k
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
        (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom)).obj
          ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q).obj
            (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)))) =
      Module.finrank k ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ g.appTop).hom)).obj
            ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q).obj
              (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))))
